name: Andhra Pradesh
description: The Sunrise State featuring sacred shrines, Coringa mangroves, Gandikota canyon, and scenic Araku hill ranges.

name: Arunachal Pradesh
description: Land of Dawn-lit Mountains, high alpine passes, Tawang monastery, and pristine eastern Himalayan river valleys.

name: Assam
description: Abode of the one-horned rhinoceros, ancient Kamakhya Shaktipeeth, world-famous lush tea gardens, and mighty Brahmaputra river island Majuli.

name: Bihar
description: Cradle of ancient empires, Bodh Gaya enlightenment tree, ruins of ancient Nalanda University, and historic Rajgir.

name: Chhattisgarh
description: Heartland of tribal heritage, Chitrakote Niagara falls, Kanger Valley limestone caverns, and ancient Sirpur ruins.

name: Goa
description: Sun, sand, Portuguese heritage churches, tranquil backwaters, Dudhsagar falls, and spice plantations.

name: Gujarat
description: White Rann salt desert, Asiatic lions of Gir, Somnath and Dwarka shrines, and Rani ki Vav stepwell.

name: Haryana
description: Land of epic Kurukshetra Mahabharata battleground, Sultanpur migratory bird wetlands, and Morni hills.

name: Himachal Pradesh
best_season: March to June / Dec to Feb for snow
description: Land of the Gods, snow-capped Himalayan peaks, pine forests, Rohtang pass, Dharamshala monasteries, and paragliding in Bir Billing.

name: Jharkhand
description: Land of forests and waterfalls, Hundru & Dassam falls, Betla tiger reserve, sacred Shikharji peak, and tribal metalcraft.

name: Karnataka
description: One State, Many Worlds — royal Mysuru palace, coffee estates of Coorg and Chikmagalur, Gokarna beaches, and Jog Falls.

name: Kerala
description: God's Own Country — emerald backwaters of Alappuzha, Munnar tea hills, Varkala cliff beach, and Athirappilly waterfalls.

name: Madhya Pradesh
description: The Heart of Incredible India — Khajuraho temples, Kanha and Bandhavgarh tiger reserves, Sanchi Stupa, and Pachmarhi hills.

name: Maharashtra
description: Land of Maratha forts, Western Ghats misty hill stations like Lonavala and Mahabaleshwar, Konkan coastline, and vibrant Mumbai.

name: Manipur
description: Jewel of India — Loktak floating phumdis lake, Keibul Lamjao national park, Kangla fort, and Ukhrul Shirui lily peaks.

name: Meghalaya
description: Abode of Clouds — living root bridges of Cherrapunji, crystal clear Dawki Umngot river, Mawlynnong clean village, and cascading waterfalls.

name: Mizoram
description: Land of Rolling Hills, Vantawng waterfall, Reiek mountain views, Phawngpui Blue Mountain, and traditional Mizo handloom culture.

name: Nagaland
description: Land of Festivals — Hornbill festival in Kisama, pristine Dzukou Valley trekking, Khonoma green village, and rich Naga tribal culture.

name: Odisha
description: Soul of Incredible India — Puri Jagannath shrine, Konark Sun Temple UNESCO heritage, Chilika Lake dolphin sanctuary, and Simlipal tigers.

name: Punjab
description: Land of Five Rivers — Golden Temple in Amritsar, Wagah Border patriotism, Virasat-e-Khalsa, and rich Punjabi folk heritage.

name: Rajasthan
description: Land of Kings — Amber Fort, Thar desert golden dunes of Jaisalmer, Lake Pichola in Udaipur, and Mehrangarh Fort in Jodhpur.

name: Sikkim
best_season: March to May / Oct to Dec
description: Himalayan Wonderland — views of Mount Kanchenjunga, high altitude Tsomgo lake, Gurudongmar, Rumtek monastery, and Yumthang valley of flowers.

name: Tamil Nadu
description: Land of Temples and Hill Retreats — Meenakshi Amman Temple, Mahabalipuram shore monuments, queen of hills Ooty, and misty Kodaikanal.

name: Telangana
description: City of Pearls and Kakatiya Heritage — Charminar, Golconda Fort, Ramappa UNESCO temple, Thousand Pillar Temple, and Kuntala falls.

name: Tripura
description: Queen of Eastern Hills — Ujjayanta Palace, rock-carved Unakoti sculptures, floating Neermahal palace in Rudrasagar lake, and Jampui orange hills.

name: Uttar Pradesh
description: Heart of India's cultural tapestry — Taj Mahal UNESCO wonder, sacred Varanasi ghats, Ayodhya Ram Mandir, Vrindavan, and Nawabi Lucknow.

name: Uttarakhand
best_season: March to June / Sep to Nov
description: Devbhoomi — Chardham pilgrimage shrines of Badrinath and Kedarnath, yoga capital Rishikesh, Queen of Hills Mussoorie, and skiing in Auli.

name: West Bengal
description: Cultural Capital of India — Victoria Memorial, Sundarbans mangrove tiger reserve, terracotta temples of Bishnupur, and Darjeeling hills.

name: Jammu & Kashmir (UT)
description: Paradise on Earth — Dal Lake Shikara rides, Gulmarg Gondola snowfields, Betaab Valley in Pahalgam, Gurez valley, and Sonamarg glaciers.
